title: Prove live Linux recovery inspection is non-mutating
description: Add one high-value Linux acceptance boundary for the canonical independent recovery-state inspector. During the existing real ublk/ext4 guest lifecycle, invoke `dwv-recovery-inspect --json` after the first workload is unmounted but before the live `dwv demo disk serve` process is terminated, while that process still owns `recovery.sqlite3.dwv-lock`. Prove the inspector can observe the real workload-advanced SQLite artifact without acquiring writable ownership or mutating the database or lock sidecar. This task does not authorize recovery, repair, migration, clean-state, durability, stable-format, or production-service claims.
design: The likely insertion point is `tools/linux-disk-acceptance/guest.sh` immediately after the first `umount "$mountpoint"` and before `kill -TERM "$server_pid"`; update `tools/linux-disk-acceptance/run.sh` only as needed to build the standalone binary. Snapshot the database bytes and lock-sidecar existence/content before and after. Require a status-0 JSON observation with the canonical command schema, supported classification, experimental format claim, bounded non-null manifest, `next_action=none`, and complete non-authorization statement. JSON-only is sufficient because focused command tests already prove human/JSON equivalence. Before implementation, retrieve current canonical context and create or update the bounded OpenSpec artifacts required by the repository workflow; this Bead is execution state, not semantic authority.
acceptance_criteria: The pickup agent has created or updated and validated any required OpenSpec change before product/evidence edits; the Linux guest builds and invokes `dwv-recovery-inspect` while the service still owns the live recovery lock; the assertion fails if inspection takes writable ownership, depends on the production command path, cannot read the real workload-advanced artifact, changes database bytes, or changes/removes the lock sidecar; exact JSON classification, evidence tier, experimental scope, non-claims, and process status are checked without promoting the observation to authority; the focused Linux acceptance command passes; applicable knowledge, documentation, and OpenSpec gates pass; implementation and evidence links are recorded against the canonical requirement.
notes: Investigation evidence: `SqliteRecoveryStore::inspect` uses the read-only sqlite path and does not call `acquire_lock`; `Fixture::open` and `serve_with_publication` keep the writable recovery owner alive through the guest insertion point. Existing unit/CLI tests already cover all six classifications, renderer equivalence, and ordinary non-mutation; macOS APFS uses `MemoryRecoveryStore`. Do not add this test merely as CLI wiring or duplicate absent/corrupt classification coverage.

title: Prove independent parity verifier
description: Apply OpenSpec tasks 2.1-2.2 after implementation. Add focused executable evidence for matching equations, mismatches, short and failed reads, logical zero tails, invalid geometry and bounds, duplicate or aliased paths, unchanged source hashes, renderer equivalence, deterministic status, hostile bounds, experimental claim scope, and import/dependency isolation.
design: Use disposable regular-file fixtures and bounded assertions. Prove byte-for-byte non-mutation and exact disposition boundaries without source-text tests or broad snapshots. Evidence must remain file-backed/model tier and must not claim hardware durability, current or historical authority, clean state, repair authorization, recovery, stable format, C8a/U26a, or U11 behavior.
acceptance_criteria: OpenSpec tasks 2.1-2.2 are complete; focused evidence fails on fake zero fill, silent truncation, repair inference, premature stronger claims, or renderer/status drift; all fixtures remain unchanged; dependency evidence excludes production service/operator/frontend, SQLite, recovery-state inspection, and portable shutdown; this Bead remains unclaimed until implementation evidence is ready.

title: Implement standalone parity verifier

Add the experimental descriptor parser and standalone executable beside portable verification code, validate single-XOR geometry and distinct bounded payloads before reads, perform exact read-only region checks with declared zero tails, and render equivalent human/JSON outcomes with fixed process statuses.

Keep this binary independent of diskweave, dwv-service, dwv-frontend-ublk, SQLite adapters, recovery-state inspection, and operator private state. Do not add repair, rebuild, parity build, migration, publication, recovery, session/shutdown, candidate export, or stable-format behavior.
acceptance_criteria: OpenSpec tasks 1.1-1.3 are complete; matching, mismatched, incomplete, zero-tail, invalid/unsupported, and alias inputs produce the specified bounded outcomes; no input or source is written; human and structured outputs and statuses are deterministic; dependency evidence shows no C8a/U26a or U11 dependency; the Bead remains unclaimed until implementation begins.

title: Reconcile U11 writable-session lifecycle prerequisite
description: Reconcile the missing durable writable-session lifecycle required before U11 implementation. Current RecoveryMutation types can begin and close a writable session, but HealthyPortableService has no owner-approved begin/close path and therefore cannot prove close-session evidence without fabricating a clean result.
design: Inspect current canonical recovery-session, admission/start, checkpoint, endpoint, and claim owners and define the smallest durable semantic owner and executable work boundary. U03, U08, and U25 are review inputs only, not presumed unblockers. Amend U11 or create a separate bounded OpenSpec change only as the reconciliation proves; do not implement product code or infer a clean transition from flush, timeout, process exit, or endpoint removal.
acceptance_criteria: A durable OpenSpec plan names one canonical owner for writable-session begin/close, exact admissible close evidence, and failure/restart consequences; the U11 change and Bead graph cite the proven prerequisite; dwv-hg0.1 becomes ready only when that semantic work is implementation-ready; no speculative dependency, product implementation, clean-close claim, or unrelated campaign closure is introduced.
notes: Repository handoff: durable state is the integrated OpenSpec change openspec/changes/add-portable-shutdown-claim-release plus this Bead dependency graph. Do not depend on or resume the current local agent workspace; create a fresh owned jj workspace under work/workspaces/ from integrated main.

A running service closes admission, drains or hands off admitted work, obtains exact owner-approved evidence, withdraws writable endpoints, and releases claims only when no writable alias remains. Incomplete, forced, or process-lost shutdown stays failure or reconciliation-required and preserves dirty or indeterminate consequences. This chain does not authorize startup, post-gap publication/currentization, recovery mutation, retention, history, repair, migration, stable-format claims, or the open recovery-inspection change.

Existing lifecycle, operation-slot, transaction, dirty, watermark, and recovery-fence requirements remain owners of their predicates. The Linux requirement is a platform refinement for ublk endpoint and OS descriptor ownership. Follow the OpenSpec delta; do not create a second lifecycle framework or broaden into another campaign row.
